description: Complete guide to Aarhus, Central Jutland: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Aarhus is a city in Central Jutland with a population of 280,000. Denmark’s second city and cultural hub, known for its ARoS art museum, Viking history, and vibrant food scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
